policy: Expected failures execute their desired assertions and match only the documented assertion path and message fragment. A failure is reported as XFAIL; an unexpected pass exits non-zero until the exemption and baseline entry are deliberately removed. Execution errors, precondition failures, different assertion failures, and process/version failures exit non-zero.
